title: keldynai/web-security ignore file
description: Justified suppressions for keldynai/web-security. Every entry must name a scanner and carry a written reason; an expiry date is optional but recommended. This schema is provided for editor autocompletion and is not the enforcement mechanism: src/ignores.mjs applies additional rules (minimum reason length, placeholder-reason rejection, expiry enforcement, duplicate detection) that JSON Schema cannot express.

id.description: Finding identifier: a CVE, a GHSA, an npm advisory id (NPM-1234), a Trivy check id (AVD-DS-0002), a Semgrep rule id, or a Gitleaks rule id.

scanner.description: Scanner whose finding is suppressed. 'dependency' covers npm, yarn and pnpm; 'any' covers every scanner.

reason.description: Why this finding is acceptable in this application. Placeholder text such as 'n/a' or 'false positive' is rejected.

expires.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which this suppression stops applying and the run fails until it is re-reviewed.

package.description: Restrict the suppression to one package name.

paths.description: Restrict the suppression to these repository-relative paths. Supports '*' (one path segment) and '**' (any depth).
